text:
Aisha: Drafting rollout plan for the "priority-routing" feature (tenant-scoped routing + per-region fallback). Key asks: canary cadence, gating queries, and customer opt-in flow. Proposing: smoke (internal 24h), phase1 (5% 48h), phase2 (25% 24h), full. Also want an AB holdback of 3% mirrored traffic for quality checks.

Tom: Agree on cadence but suggest phase1 be 72h for signal on tail latency. Gates: p95 increase >15% OR error_rate>0.3% => pause. Also require cost delta <1.3x.

Evan: Telemetry list: p50/p95/p99 latency by region, infra_errors_5m, model_oom_count, token_cost_ratio, match_rate_on_golden. Runbook snippet: 1) pause rollout job 2) set per-tenant override 3) verify traffic drains 4) notify customers.

Priya: Product launch checklist: docs + support playbook, enable per-tenant preview API, legal sign-off for EU opt-ins, two enterprise opt-ins confirmed. AB success criteria: golden match_rate >= baseline -0.7%.

rollout-bot: orchestration scheduled -> priority-routing canary -> smoke window 2026-05-02T03:00:00Z

Aisha: Final: freeze unrelated model flags during canary, assign oncall for first 72h, and annotate rollout with correlation id. I'll update PRD and shiproom invite.
